title: Erase a guardian and their children, in one request that survives being interrupted
summary: A guardian's erasure can carry their linked children with it - but only when the officer asks for it. The interesting part is what happens if the request dies half way: the plan is written down before the first child is touched, so an interrupted cascade is describable and resumable instead of being a silent half-erasure.

steps.label: A guardian
steps.note: The person who will make the Article 17 request.

steps.label: A child, as their own person
steps.note: Separate record, separate pseudonym, separate rights - the link describes the relationship without merging them.

steps.label: Link them as guardian and child
steps.note: guardian is one of three named link types. It is what the cascade will follow - and only because the officer names it.

steps.label: Erase the guardian WITHOUT asking for a cascade
steps.note: The default is deliberately narrow: erasing one person never quietly erases another. A cascade destroys a second person's data, which has to be an explicit instruction, not a side effect.

steps.label: The child is untouched
steps.note: Still readable: the guardian's erasure took the guardian's data and the link, and stopped there.

steps.label: A second family, this time cascaded
steps.note: Fresh guardian and child, so the cascade has something to follow.

steps.label: Link them
steps.note: Both ends in the same scope - a link can never cross a scope boundary.

steps.label: Erase the guardian AND their guardian-linked children
steps.note: One request names the link types to follow. Before the first child is touched, the cascade writes down its plan - which children, from which erasure - so a request that dies half way leaves a record of what was still owed rather than a mystery.

steps.label: The guardian is gone
steps.note: Tombstoned like any erased person: the pseudonym still resolves so client references do not break, but there is nothing behind it.

steps.label: And so is the child the cascade followed
steps.note: Erased under the SAME erasure id as the guardian, so the audit trail answers 'why was this person erased' with 'as part of erasure N', not with silence.

steps.label: The first child - never cascaded - is still here
steps.note: The contrast that makes the point: cascading is a decision, and the decision was made for one family and not the other.
